title: ReverseMC
description: This project makes minecraft played in reverse!
body:
# Backwards Minecraft

**Backwards Minecraft** flips the entire game on its head.  
Everything you expect from vanilla is reversed, inverted, or outright wrong.  
Survive in a world where the rules no longer make sense — and that’s the point.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🌀 World Logic Reversed
- You **spawn in the End**, not the Overworld.  
- A **3×4 dirt portal** is your only way home.  
- **Day and night are swapped** — mobs spawn in daylight and burn at night.

---

## 💀 Survival Is Backwards
- **Death is beneficial**: respawn with full health and a bonus item.  
- **Food drains hunger**, while **eating ores restores it**.  
- **Standing still drains hunger**, but **sprinting restores it**.  
- Wood tools are **stronger than netherite** — progression is reversed.

---

## 👹 Mob Behavior Rewritten
- **Arrow Spiders**: spiders now fight at range using bows.  
- **Melee Skeletons**: skeletons rush you down instead of shooting.  
- **Hostile Iron Golems**: small, fast, aggressive, and absolutely unhinged.  
- **Villagers attack on sight**, while **zombies trade** with you.

---

## 🧱 Block & Item Inversions
- **Logs drop stone**, and **stone drops logs**.  
- **Gravity is reversed** for sand, gravel, and anvils — they fall upward.

---

## 📘 In‑Game Guidebook
Every player receives a formatted guidebook explaining all reversed mechanics.  
No guessing required — the chaos is documented.

---

## 🎯 Why Play This Mod?
Backwards Minecraft is perfect for:
- Challenge runs  
- Chaos SMPs  
- Content creators  
- Players who think they’ve “mastered” Minecraft  
- Anyone who wants to laugh, cry, and question reality

---

## 📦 Compatibility
- Designed for **NeoForge**  
- Works in **singleplayer** and **dedicated servers** (with correct registry setup)

---
